# Idea Kitchen

> Simple recipes for everyday AI, made for humans. A weekly newsletter by Marissa Goldberg that turns AI overwhelm into simple, practical recipes for real life: work, home, decisions, planning, and the small tasks that quietly eat your day.

Idea Kitchen is written by Marissa Goldberg, founder of Remote Work Prep. Each "recipe" is a short, step-by-step AI workflow for a real everyday task, written for curious, non-technical humans who want AI to feel useful instead of overwhelming. The full recipes are published on Substack; this website is the home, the browsable recipe index, and the place to work with Marissa.

## Pages
- [Home](https://ideakitchen.ai/): What Idea Kitchen is, who it's for, and how to subscribe.
- [Recipe Box](https://ideakitchen.ai/recipes.html): Browsable, filterable index of all AI recipes (by tool, difficulty, and prep time). Each recipe links to the full step-by-step article on Substack.
- [About](https://ideakitchen.ai/about.html): The story behind Idea Kitchen, who it is for, and how Marissa thinks about practical AI.
- [Work With Us](https://ideakitchen.ai/services.html): Memberships, team training, AI assessments, group coaching, and 1:1 coaching for individuals and teams. Includes FAQs.

## Recipes
The full archive of step-by-step AI recipes is published on Substack: https://ideakitchen.substack.com

## Author
Marissa Goldberg — founder of Remote Work Prep and Idea Kitchen. Writes about practical AI, remote work, and the future of work; a longtime advocate for working smarter, not longer.
